title: Barack Obama Singing Call Me Maybe by Carly Rae Jepsen
summary: A 2012 parody dub that splices clips of Barack Obama speaking into a performance of Carly Rae Jepsen's 'Call Me Maybe'. It is a short comedic mashup built entirely from re-ordered snippets of his real speech.
why: HN commenters cite it as a silly but clear example of how cutting and reordering real footage can fabricate meaning without any deepfake technology.

quote.text: you might be surprised at what can be accomplished with camera angles, choosing the start and end times of your clip, and cuts and reordering of clips
